long_description:
Join us for a unique outdoor yoga experience that combines beginner friendly yoga, fresh air, laughter, and plenty of goat interaction. Whether you’re coming with friends, family, coworkers, or just looking for a fun and memorable outing, goat yoga is designed to be relaxed and enjoyable for all experience levels.

Please dress appropriately for the weather, as this is an outdoor event.

For safety reasons, children under the age of 5 are not permitted inside the fenced goat yoga participation area at any time, including as observers or accompanying guests.

Know Before You Go:

• Please do not enter the fenced goat yoga area earlier than 15 minutes before your scheduled class time. We’ll leave extra time after class for photos and socializing with the goats.

• BYOM (Bring Your Own Mat) — We do not provide yoga mats, but large towels will be available for all attendees. We also provide bottled water, sunscreen, bug spray, hand sanitizer, and wipes.

• Be prepared for our goats to take an interest in you! Goat yoga is designed to be lighthearted and interactive. Our goats may nudge, nibble, scratch, jump, or step on guests during class. Children ages 5+ are welcome with a participating parent or guardian.

• Most of our goats are Nigerian Dwarf goats and are generally under 25 pounds, though some of our larger personalities can occasionally reach 30–35 pounds.

• Our goats are not potty trained animals. While we do our best to keep the space clean throughout the session, occasional droppings are a normal and expected part of the experience. Sanitizing stations and antibacterial wipes will be available.

• All attendees must check in and complete a provided liability waiver prior to class. Masks are not required. Social distancing and personal comfort levels regarding proximity to others are left to each attendee’s discretion.

Our tribe looks forward to meeting you!
